landscape.noOrder: This base has no learning order (“First you need to know”) — everything you don't know yet stands on the plain.
landscape.cycles: There are circles in the learning order ({n}) — each counts as one step; fix them in “To do”.

detour.crossOptional: A detour into another world (“{flow}”) is always optional — "optional": false does not apply.
detour.noFlow: The detour points to no story ("flow") — the learner will only see “Next”.
detour.missing: The detour points to the story “{flow}”, which is neither in the document nor in the base — the learner will only see “Next”.
detour.self: The detour leads to the same story {name} — a story cannot enter itself.
detour.cycle: The detours form a circle: {ring} — a story cannot return to itself through detours. Remove one of them.
detour.deep: The detours go deeper than {depth} levels: {chain} — the player will not offer the deepest one.

offline.locked: Without internet the person's private key is locked.

oldCopies.done: Old public copies withdrawn: {withdrawn}, copies removed from entries: {stripped}, file copies withdrawn: {files}.
oldCopies.kept: Copies left: {n} — they show entries that are no longer in the base (restore them from the entry history or keep the copy; while it exists, this base cannot be opened to everyone).
oldCopies.failed: Could not withdraw files: {n} — try again.

presentation.noAccess: You have no access to this knowledge base.
presentation.noWrite: You do not write in this knowledge base — the run can be created by someone who writes in it.
presentation.name: Presentation

python.loadTooLong: Python took too long to load — check the internet and try again.
python.startFailed: Could not start Python (the first time needs the internet): {error}
python.loadTimeout: The code runs too long already at start (over {s} s) — is some loop outside the function transform?
python.nothing: This question has no examples or hidden cases to check.
python.notRunQuestion: Not run — error in the question (create_input/reference): {error}
python.tooManyTimeouts: Not run — the code exceeded the time {n} times.
python.needTransform: You need to define a function: def transform(x):
python.needRun: The code must define a function run(*inputs).

generator.noEntry: “{name}”: no entry of the kind “{kind}” fits.
generator.noEntryWhere: “{name}”: no entry of the kind “{kind}” fits “{where}”.
generator.overrun: “{name}”: too much computing (lists longer than the language allows or too many steps).
generator.unmet: The condition “{source}” could not be met in {total} draws — widen the ranges or relax the conditions.

samples.noCardWhy: The card was not made — an answer or options are missing.
samples.madeTries: {k} of {n} succeeded · on average {tries} draws per task.
samples.madeTriesRejected: {k} of {n} succeeded · on average {tries} draws per task ({pct}% rejected).
samples.title: Example tasks ({n})

says.learning: recently wrong or forgotten — back to learning
says.due: you know it, and now it needs a review
says.known: you know it — before the review date

quiltView.noQuestionsYet: This entry has no questions yet.
quiltView.title: Progress map
quiltView.nobodyQuestions: Nobody has answered these questions yet.
quiltView.nobodyRange: Nobody has answered in this range yet.

first.label: First time
first.says: how many answered right at once

hints.label: Hints
hints.says: hints revealed in total (in how many answers)
